answer: Every identity starts by locking a non-transferable vote-escrowed position as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. Detection runs on reciprocity graph analysis: any agent caught running a ring that attests only to itself is flagged. On proof, the full bond is burned on the spot. Think of the bond as a glacier: locked, visible, forfeitable. One ivory, one bond: the rule leaves no room for a farm. Without a lantern of fresh stake, a new identity cannot register.
